title: Security Score endpoint returns an integer within 0-100
expectedResult: data.overall is a number between 0 and 100 inclusive (never negative, never NaN, never > 100).

title: Creating an initiative with a minimal valid payload succeeds and appears in the initiative list
steps: POST /initiatives with only the required fields: name, category, priority, budget.allocated, timeline.startDate/targetDate
Call GET /initiatives and locate the new initiative
expectedResult: 201 response with the created initiative; it appears in the subsequent list call with status defaulted to 'not_started' and progress defaulted to 0.

title: Frameworks endpoint returns the documented {name, compliance} shape for every active framework
steps: Call GET /compliance-oversight/frameworks for an org with at least 2 activated frameworks
expectedResult: Response data is an array where every element has exactly a string 'name' and a rounded integer 'compliance' field.

title: Third-Party Risk summary response includes all documented summary fields
steps: Call GET /third-party-risk/summary for an org with at least one vendor
expectedResult: data.summary includes totalVendors, activeVendors, averageRiskScore, riskTrend, criticalVendors, highRiskVendors, pendingReviews, overdueReviews, complianceRate, assessedVendors, pendingAssessment, withSOC2, activeContracts — all present and correctly typed.

title: Advisor conversation create-then-list roundtrip shows the new conversation
steps: Call GET /advisor/conversations for the same user
expectedResult: The list response includes the just-created conversation with a matching conversationId, title, and conversationType.
